about: What the Controller's normalization makes of a Studio project (before and after are StudioProject documents).
rule: Normalization is idempotent and never deletes, moves or shortens a clip that carries an edit. (1) A project with shots and no timeline gets one: its enabled shots in order, each a video clip on video-1 and its linked audio clip on audio-1, with the shot's trim and effects carried into the clips (picture effects on the video clip, sound effects on the audio clip, speed, holds and the transition on both; volume_db becomes the audio clip's motion.gain_db, which the export adds to the track gain exactly as it added volume_db; a transition is an overlap; the last clip keeps none). (2) An enabled shot that never had a place gets one after the last clip of the first video and audio tracks and is listed in placed_shot_ids; until it has a finished take its source has file null and the planned length. (3) A source follows its shot: a placeholder is as long as the shot's planned length, and a finished active take is bound when it covers every clip that was cut from the source. A clip that shows the whole source with nothing timed against its length (in_frame 0, out_frame = duration_frames, no output_window, no keyframes, effect stack or mask, and no effects other than transition_out, color, mute and volume_db) follows the new length as a ripple trim with its linked partners; when that edit is refused nothing changes. A take that is shorter than an edited clip uses is named in pending_take_id and nothing else changes. (4) Every shot's in_frame, out_frame and effects are reset and enabled mirrors whether a clip shows the shot. (5) A source of a shot carries the shot's title, and so do its clips that still carry the title the source had; a clip renamed in the editor keeps its name. What could not be carried over exactly is written to timeline.migration_notes.

vectors.name: an enabled shot without a place gets a placeholder after the last clip; a disabled one stays out
a finished take that covers the clips is bound, a shorter one waits in pending_take_id, a failed one changes nothing
clips that show a whole take follow the planned length and a new take; the clips after them keep their distance
a renamed shot renames its source and the clips that still carry its old title; a clip renamed in the editor keeps its name
